story.body: You stood through Master Thwaite's prayer for the west. He said forty. You knew otherwise, from yesterday, and you did not put a town or a number into the church.

relations.note: the knot that does not slip

story.body: You counted the coffer in front of Mistress Ansell and split it. You argued the pack until the list was the short one. Brooke stayed. Holinshed stayed under the cloth. Verbeke tied the strap with the knot that does not slip and said a short thing in Dutch. You did not wipe the leaf yet.

title: Counted the money and closed the pack

participation.context: Looked, and did not count again.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You had the book open long enough to see the count written, and you left it written.

description: The short list, still on the leaf

story.body: You looked at the leaf with the pack already shut. The list was still there.

title: Looked at the short list

participation.context: Wrote the list, shut the pack, and wiped the leaf.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the parcels once, fair. Once the pack was shut, you wiped the leaf. Brooke and Holinshed were not in the pack, and they were not on the leaf after that.

title: Wrote the list and wiped it

description: In bed while it is light

participation.context: Spoke it once, and did not get up again.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said where the money was, and that the list was gone. You stayed in bed.

title: Said where the money was and stayed in bed
